dataset: Wheel Fitment Research 2026-08-22 vehicle platform layer
scope: Platform-level evidence for PCD, hub bore, OEM brake baseline, common aftermarket ranges and installation risks.
integrity_policy: Target ranges are explicitly non-approved. Exact year, trim, market, brake kit, coilover, tyre and measured clearance remain mandatory.

prechecks.note: 日本老车常见 PCD/中心孔通过；刹车与绞牙需量测
Type R 版本通过；刹车模板仍需复核
漂移车如改 knuckle/BBK/翼子板，必须替换为实车测量
PCD/CB 通过不代表 390 mm 级卡钳通过
演示行：若实测值成立，硬约束预筛为 PASS
PCD/CB 通过；GTI/R 刹车与 MQB 前筒身仍需具体模板
同 PCD 的 Camaro/Corvette 不能直接共用，螺栓/中心孔/ET 都要核对
Performance Pack/Shelby 刹车不能按 GT 基础版判断
故意示范：PCD 硬冲突，整体结果应为 REJECT
